messages:
maria: Heads up 1: embeddings and similarity service is returning higher latency for a subset of customers. Can marketing help with status language and inbound handling?

noah: Engineering: identified a regression in a recent KV-cache change. Rolling it back now. ETA 30-60m for validation.

incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-21-embeddings-deg created by noah.

priya: Recommendation: publish a concise statuspage entry for all users, send targeted enterprise email after we confirm recovery, and send a one-sentence registrant message for today's webinar. Hold any external benchmark posts.

sam: Sales request: pause automated lead notifications to SFDC for 1 hour and route new signups to incident-inbound@redwood.com. SDRs will monitor but not outreach.

maria: Draft statuscopy: "We9re investigating degraded performance for embedding endpoints. Engineers are rolling back a recent cache change and routing traffic to a stable path. Next update in 30 minutes. Enterprise customers with time-sensitive jobs: contact support@redwood.com."

priya: Registrant DM draft: "Quick update: today9s live demo will skip any real-time embedding demos due to a platform issue. We9ll share a new time within 48 hours. Follow status.redwood.com for updates."

noah: Ops will publish first public update in ~20m once rollback begins and we see improving p95 latency.

maria: Also pause paid channels and scheduled social/benchmark posts until we mark incident resolved.

sam: Done 1 SFDC webhook paused and routing set to incident-inbound.

priya: For Dedicated/Enterprise customers: have account teams send a short note offering a priority call; tag tickets as "incident-priority".

maria: Thanks. Action items: priya send registrant DM now, noah post status update when metrics look stable, sam confirm SFDC pause (confirmed). Keep updates here short. :pray:
